correctness.rationale: Cai–Kiah–Nguyen–Yaakobi Proposition 9 supplies the exactly-two-read Type-A pair edge criterion: opposite alternating phases on a unique first/last difference interval. For three pairwise adjacent words three distinct letters at one position would force contradictory alternating neighbors, so exactly zero or two edge intervals cover each coordinate. Three integral intervals then form a unique long interval and two adjacent disjoint shorter intervals, each length>=2, with cut choices ell-3 and two splice orientations. Counting outside context and symbol pair gives formula and OGF. Independent direct deletion-descendant graph K3 enumeration tested 11 (q,n) cases through binary n=7, ternary n=4, in agreement. Finite checks corroborate, not prove all q,n.
residual_risks: Finite independent calculations do not establish untested infinite cases; unrestricted conclusions rest on proof lemmas.

residual_risks: Does not determine maximum cliques, all reconstruction code sizes or higher cliques.

final_claim: For all q>=2,n>=1, unordered K3 count in graph on q-ary length-n words joined iff >=2 distinct shared length n-1 deletion descendants: T_q(n)=q(q-1)*sum_{ell=4}^n (n-ell+1)(ell-3)q^(n-ell), and OGF q(q-1)z^4/[(1-qz)^2(1-z)^2].
limitations: Does not determine maximum cliques, all reconstruction code sizes or higher cliques.
